# Autocorrelation

::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives
- Understand what autocorrelation is and why it commonly appears in time series data
- Recognize how autocorrelation affects efficiency and inference
- Learn standard approaches to dealing with serial correlation
:::

::: {.callout-important}
### Key Takeaways
- Autocorrelation does not bias OLS coefficients under strict exogeneity
- Standard errors are invalid in the presence of serial correlation
- Correcting for autocorrelation is essential for valid inference
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### Common Pitfalls
- Assuming independent errors in time series regressions
- Ignoring serial correlation in panel data with time dimension
- Applying corrections without understanding the data-generating process
:::
